ABOUT.HEADING: About Me
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: Hello, I'm Héctor Adrián Román, a Senior Full Stack Developer with a proven track record of over 4 years at the Government of Durango State (CETIC). I specialize in architecting and delivering complex government and enterprise applications. My expertise spans the development of secure, scalable web applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, and enterprise databases such as Oracle and PostgreSQL. I have successfully led both monolithic and microservices-based projects, delivering solutions that support thousands of concurrent users. I am proficient in the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and stakeholder engagement to production deployment, leveraging agile methodologies and modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure high-quality, timely delivery.
